title: OSCAL4Rail Rules Layer (Layer 2) — decision logic artifact
description: Standalone schema for an OSCAL4Rail Rules Layer artifact (a 'rule-set'), the separate linked decision-logic artifact per ADR-014, realized OSCAL-native per ADR-018. A rule-set is bound to its catalog by the control via link rel='decision-logic' and version-coupled via metadata.version (tool check, not schema). The decision logic uses the NIST-native parameter/constraint/test/expression slot with a deterministic Metapath 'Subset v1'; lateral relations use the NIST Control Mapping Model (separate artifact). This schema deliberately does NOT $ref the NIST schema; it validates the rule-set's own additive structure. Vocabularies for modality/status/enforcement are owner-declared and bound to a fixed semantics axis the agent reads (ADR-018 point 8). See docs/reference/rules-layer.md and ADR-018.

metadata.description: NIST-style metadata. 'version' MUST equal the bound catalog's version (enforced by the validation tool, not this schema — ADR-014).

catalog-ref.description: Which catalog this rule-set serves: identity (catalog-uuid) + resolution (href). The catalog's owner/publisher and regulation live in the catalog's own metadata (SSOT), not here. Belonging is established here + the control's link rel='decision-logic' (ADR-014/ADR-018).

catalog-uuid.description: Stable identity of the served catalog (the catalog's uuid); location-independent SSOT anchor.

href.description: Where the tool resolves the catalog file (path or URL). A resolution hint, not the identity.

vocabularies.description: Owner-declared vocabularies, each bound to a fixed semantics axis the agent reads (ADR-018 point 8). The agent never reads the label semantically — only the bound axis.

modality.description: Obligation STRENGTH. Each declared label maps to a fixed axis: binding (bool) + rank (int, lower = stronger).

status.description: Lifecycle. Each declared label maps to: active (bool).

enforcement.description: How the rule is meant to be enforced. Each declared label maps to a fixed kind (MHC-relevant). Declaration only; evaluation is L4 (ADR-018 point 9).

ordinal-scales.description: Named ordered vocabularies for ordinal comparison in applies-when (e.g. schutzbedarf: [normal, hoch, sehr-hoch]). Order is the array order; ordinal comparison is undefined without a declared scale (ADR-018 Subset v1).

parameters.description: Calibratable parameters referenced by applies-when via param('<id>'). Values MAY be dated (temporal values, ADR-018 point 6).

rule-groups.description: Obligation RELATION between rules (alternative/choice). choice is fixed framework semantics (ADR-018 point 8).

o4r-id.description: Chapter-based ID: <regulation>-<chapter>[.<section>][.<subsection>...][-<context>]. Never page-based. See catalog-format.md §2.

modality-binding.description: Fixed semantics axis for an obligation-strength label (ADR-018 point 8). 'polarity' distinguishes an obligation (required) from a prohibition (forbidden); a 'MUSS' and a 'DARF NICHT' are both binding but opposite in polarity.

polarity.description: Fixed framework semantics: whether the rule mandates or prohibits.

lifecycle.description: Fixed framework lifecycle axis for a status label. 'active' = in force; 'draft' = not yet in force; 'deprecated' = still binding for existing (legacy) systems but not for new ones; 'superseded' = replaced by another rule (see superseded-by); 'withdrawn' = retired without replacement.

superseded-by.description: When lifecycle is 'superseded': the rule-id of the rule that replaces this one.

kind.description: Fixed MHC-relevant kind. Only these three values are framework-defined.

values.description: Dated value history (temporal values, ADR-018 point 6). Most recent applicable entry wins.

choice.description: Fixed framework semantics, mapped onto NIST parameter-selection/@how-many (ADR-018 point 8).

rule.description: One rule: the decision logic + obligation for a control (ADR-018 point 8).

modality.description: A label declared in vocabularies.modality (not a free value).

enforcement.description: Labels declared in vocabularies.enforcement. A rule may be enforced in several ways at once (e.g. deterministic gate AND human sign-off). Declaration only; evaluation is L4 (ADR-018 point 9).

source-ref.description: SSOT pointer; no verbatim duplication of statement text.

deviations.description: Conflict-as-data (K11). Declaration only; status/approval is L4 (ADR-018 point 9).

remarks.description: Owner prose, always allowed; never read by the agent for semantics (ADR-018).

applies-when.description: Decision logic as an OSCAL-native constraint test. 'expression' is a Metapath Subset v1 string (ADR-018 point 2); 'description' is the human-readable gloss. The expression is what the agent evaluates deterministically.

expression.description: Metapath Subset v1. Allowed: and/or/not, comparison/threshold (=,!=,<,<=,>,>=), ordinal comparison over a declared scale, context('<dimension>'), param('<id>'), set membership x=('a','b'), literals. Forbidden: arbitrary axis navigation, non-deterministic/environment functions, recursion, reading the verbatim statement. See ADR-018.
